title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£60,000 - £65,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!</p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help embed our software capitalisation process working closely with our engineering and business teams to create an automated and scalable solution.</li> <li>Take on the role of product owner for the financial reporting processes of software capitalisation, operating key controls across month end close and performing impairment assessments.</li> <li>Use your strong technical knowledge of relevant IFRS standards for capitalisation and impairment to support and challenge the business on areas of judgement and documentary evidence.</li> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£60,000 - £65,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Senior Director Global, BI Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit  <a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>

Grounded in analytics & insights and powered by data & technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. title: Senior Partnerships Manager: Media & Editorial (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong> </p> <p>Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.</p> <p>This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.</p> <p>This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p><strong>Land flagship media partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.</li> <li>Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.</li> <li>Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build the publisher value proposition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.</li> <li>Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms</li> <li>Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing</li> <li>Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.</li> <li>Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.</li> <li>Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the technical and contractual path to live</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.</li> <li>Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global reach and internal leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.</li> <li>Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.</li> <li>Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.</li> <li>Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.</li> <li>Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (first 12 months)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume</li> <li>A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.</li> <li>A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.</li> <li>Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.</li> <li>Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.</li> <li>Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.</li> <li>An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.</li> <li>Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.</li> <li>Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.</li> <li>International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.</li> <li>Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.</li> <li>Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.</li> <li>Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.</li> <li>Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.</li> <li>Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.</li> <li>Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.</li> <li>Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.</li> <li>Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.</li> <li>Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.</li> <li>Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.</li> <li>Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.</li> <li>Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.</li> <li>Fluent English essential. German or another European language advantageous.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to relevant markets as required<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p> <div class="TypographyPresentation description: <div><strong>Head of Engineering - Developer Experience & Platform</strong></div> <p>Awin is seeking an exceptional engineering leader to shape the future of how our engineers build, ship, and operate software at scale. You will define and deliver the developer experience (DevEx) vision for Awin, ensuring our engineers have the tools, environments, processes, and culture to be highly productive and deeply satisfied in their work. You will own our platform strategy on AWS, lead FinOps practices, and spearhead the organisation-wide rollout of AI-augmented and agentic development workflows.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted internal champion for engineers – gathering data-driven insight, translating it into organisation-wide improvements, and working hand-in-hand with engineering leadership, product, and stakeholders to make change happen and allow our Product teams to deliver value to our customers at scale.</p> <p>The right candidate has strong hands-on experience with modern AI-driven software development and building developer-centric cloud platforms at scale. This is a senior but hands-on role within the Engineering organisation, reporting to the Director of Engineering.</p> <div><strong>Key Tasks & Responsibilities</strong></div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Developer Experience Strategy & Tooling</strong></div> <ul> <li>Own and evolve Awin's Developer Experience programme – defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for DevEx improvement teams, other Heads of Engineering or Engineering Managers</li> <li>Drive organisation-wide improvements to technology, tooling, and engineering processes, building consensus and alignment with key stakeholders across product, engineering, security, and operations.</li> <li>Establish and track DevEx metrics and KPIs (e.g. DORA metrics, developer satisfaction scores), using them to demonstrate impact and guide investment decisions.</li> <li>Own the developer tools portfolio and associated budgets – evaluating, procuring, and retiring tools to ensure engineers have best-in-class tooling without unnecessary cost or complexity.</li> <li>Lead strategic assessment and rollout of new developer tooling, including CI/CD platforms, IDE capabilities, code quality and security tools.</li> </ul> <div><strong>AI-Native Development & Agentic Workflows</strong></div> <ul> <li>Lead Awin's AI engineering rollout – defining the strategy for AI-native software development, establishing standards, and scaling adoption across the engineering organisation.</li> <li>Evaluate and implement AI-augmented development tools including AI coding assistants, agentic development environments, automated code review, test generation, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Champion modern AI-native software development best practices and drive continuous evaluation of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape.</li> <li>Design and deliver enablement programmes – training, communities of practice, documentation, and hands-on workshops – to accelerate AI fluency and confidence across engineering teams.</li> <li>Measure and report on the impact of AI adoption on developer productivity, code quality, and time-to-market.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Cloud Platform Optimisation</strong></div> <ul> <li>Lead the strategy and execution of cloud platform standardisation across Awin's AWS estate, establishing golden paths, reference architectures, and platform abstractions that improve developer experience and reduce cognitive load.</li> <li>Drive cloud migration efforts, infrastructure modernisation initiatives, partnering with Product teams to improve reliability, scalability, observability, and security posture (including platform-wide Incident Management, SRE</li> <li>Own AWS cost management and FinOps practices – establishing budgeting frameworks, implementing cost allocation and tagging strategies, identifying and acting on optimisation opportunities, and providing transparent reporting to leadership.</li> <li>Build out internal developer platform capabilities to abstract cloud complexity and accelerate developer self-service.</li> <li>Ensure cloud platform decisions are made with developer experience as a primary consideration alongside cost efficiency, security, and scalability.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Leadership & Organisational Impact</strong></div> <ul> <li>Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team spanning developer experience, platform engineering, and tooling functions.</li> <li>Act as a collaborative, influential engineering leader, shaping Awin's technical culture, engineering standards, and ways of working.</li> <li>Contribute to the engineering leadership team, participating in strategic planning, headcount discussions, and broader organisational design.</li> </ul> title: Senior Manager, Global Business Development Strategy & Operations
description: <h4><strong>About commercetools</strong></h4> <p>Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.</p> <p>Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of autonomous commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p>As our <strong>Senior Manager, Global BDR Function & Operations</strong>, you will lead and scale our Business Development Representative (BDR) organisation across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), you will serve as a functional leader on the Marketing Leadership Team, driving predictable enterprise pipeline growth by implementing  global outbound motions, standardizing playbooks, and being hands-on with the global BDR team. </p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the global functional lead for business development, partnering directly with the CMO to align the BDR function with overall demand generation campaigns, brand initiatives, and corporate pipeline targets.</li> <li>Partner with RevOps and Marketing to define, monitor, and optimize global Marketing–BDR SLAs, including funnel velocity, lead scoring models, speed-to-lead benchmarks, and inbound conversion strategies.</li> <li>Own global team metrics against weekly discovery and qualified opportunity targets, providing direct, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.</li> <li>Manage regional BDR teams fostering high-performance leadership standards.</li> <li>Own global team retention strategies, structuring quality-weighted compensation frameworks and clear career pathways.</li> <li>Design, implement, and maintain a single global BDR playbook covering inbound and outbound architecture, multi-channel messaging (email, phone, social), and objection handling.</li> <li>Partner with the People team to support  onboarding and enablement programs globally, incorporating formal certification milestones and structured peer-shadowing.</li> <li>Collaborate with RevOps to optimize tool adoption, AI potential and workflow efficiencies across Salesforce, Clay, Outreach, Gong/Chorus, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and 6sense/intent data platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>This role is in office with five days a week spent in our (Boston MA or London UK) office. </em></strong></p> <h4><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years in B2B SaaS sales development,</li> <li>Proven track record leading distributed BDR/SDR organizations or managing regional team leads/managers across AMER, EMEA, or APAC.</li> <li>Demonstrated success partnering directly with Marketing Leadership (CMO/VPs) to convert marketing demand into qualified enterprise sales opportunities.</li> <li>Hands-on mastery of modern sales tech (Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, intent data, conversation intelligence) and funnel conversion analytics.</li> <li>AI Aptitude<strong>:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise eCommerce, headless commerce, composable platforms, or digital experience software.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p><strong>✈️ Family Flex Program:</strong> Remote work for a number of days a year to support family connectivity </p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success </p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Solutions
description: About the Company: Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience. Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team. To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers . Enterprise Solutions Manager, Managed by Industrious About Managed by Industrious For the last decade, companies with real workplace needs have solved them the hard way: building an internal real estate team, running a self-delivery project with a dozen different vendors, and hoping it all comes together on time. Managed by Industrious exists to break that model. We combine the operational expertise we've built running premium flexible workspace at scale with tailored, single-tenant solutions, so landlords and enterprise clients get a fully outsourced, hospitality-driven workplace, without the internal headcount or the fragmented delivery chain. It's our newest product line, and one of the fastest growing parts of the business. The Opportunity We're at the point where the model is proven and the demand is real, but the playbook is still being written. This role sits right at the center of that build. You'll take opportunities from a client's first conversation with us through to a signed deal and a live, operating space, working closely with the GM of Enterprise Solutions and a small, senior, fast-moving team. You won't be slotting into a fully formed process. You'll be helping define what that process becomes as the business scales across Europe. Why Industrious We've spent the last decade becoming the highest quality provider of flexible workspace in the market. Managed by Industrious is us taking that same operational rigor and hospitality standard and applying it to a completely different kind of client relationship, one where you're building a bespoke, single-tenant solution rather than selling into an existing space. It's early enough that you'll genuinely shape how this product line operates in Europe, and established enough that you're doing it with the backing, brand, and delivery capability of a company that's already proven this model works. What Might Your Day Look Like A client reaches out needing a dedicated space for a growing team, say 150 people, in a European city where we don't yet have a foothold for them. You get on the phone to understand what they're actually solving for: who's working there, what the culture needs to feel like, what's non-negotiable and what's flexible. You bring our design team in as a thought partner and land on a brief. From there you're in the market, working with brokerage channels to shortlist two or three sites that could work, and touring the client through them alongside you. Once you've got a favorite or two, you're building pricing, which means understanding the landlord's lease terms on one side and our own design, build, and operating costs on the other, and pulling all of it into a proposal that's honest about what it will take to deliver. If the client is in, you're moving toward signing high level commercial terms with them and with the landlord at close to the same time, then spending the following weeks getting both to a final agreement. The moment ink is dry, you're handing a clean, well-briefed project to design and construction, and making sure everything you promised the client is something the business can actually deliver, on time and on budget. What You Will Own You will manage the full lifecycle of a Managed by Industrious deal, from the first client conversation through to a live, operating space. You will translate what a client says they need into a workable, costed real estate and design solution, working closely with our design team to get there. You will lead landlord and broker relationships on every deal, negotiating lease terms that protect us and set the project up to succeed. You will build the commercial model and client-facing proposal for each opportunity, pulling together lease costs, build costs, and operating costs into a single coherent picture. You will run point on the transaction itself, from high level commercial terms through to final signed agreements with both the client and the landlord. You will hand projects to our design and construction teams with everything they need to deliver on what was promised, and stay close enough through delivery that nothing gets lost in the handoff. You will help build our own playbook as you go, documenting what works so the next deal moves faster than the last one. You will generate your own opportunities when the pipeline calls for it. description: About Cortea We're Cortea, a European audit-tech company, born in Berlin, rebuilding how audits are done everywhere. What You'll Do UK Market Building: Spearhead Cortea's UK market entry. You'll work hand in hand with Valentin (CEO) and the Growth and Marketing leads to build the UK go-to-market motion, and carry direct responsibility for a set of accounts as we establish the market Founder Force Multiplier: Act as a proxy for the founders in internal and external meetings, ensuring decisions are made and projects stay on track even when the founders aren't in the room Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact projects from conception to completion. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Deal Review - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits </strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits </li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance </li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office </li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided </li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.</p> <p>Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. </p> <p>Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice</strong></p> <p>Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice <a href="https://pallet.com/privacy">here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations</strong></p> <p>Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Finance and Technology stakeholders. description: Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife The Team You will join Data Privacy within Zopa’s Operational Risk and Compliance function. H elp to b uild and embed a risk-based framework for data privacy risk, including a usable view of risk appetite. Partner with data and technology teams on complex data-use and data-governance decisions. Lead the response to significant privacy issues and ensure decisions are well evidenced. Develop our Data Privacy Associate, through mentoring, standards and exposure to complex problem-solving. Create trusted relationships across the business so privacy is involved early, not at the last minute. Identify manual privacy processes that can be simplified or automated. Represent the first-line privacy perspective credibly with senior stakeholders. About You: Bring substantial practical data privacy experience, with strong working knowledge of UK GDPR and its enforcement context. Use sound judgement to balance privacy rights, customer protection, business objectives and residual risk. Explain complex privacy issues clearly to non-specialists and make credible, defensible recommendations. Have led or materially shaped privacy frameworks, governance or operating models. Are comfortable working through ambiguity and taking ownership of difficult problems independently. Build constructive relationships with product, technology, operations, legal, risk and security partners. Have managed, mentored or developed others and create an environment of clear standards and support. Recognise data and technology risks without requiring expertise in a particular tool or platform. Added bonus: Experience in fintech, technology, banking or another regulated environment. Experience of automated decision-making systems with significant or legal effects. Knowledge of privacy considerations across AI model training, prompting and outputs. Experience improving efficiency through automation of privacy processes. Legal, operational-risk or dedicated data-protection qualifications. LI-AP1 At Zopa we value flexible ways of working. We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week. You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one. *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice Diversity Statement Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. Our approach to AI in interviews At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. Behavioural and competency-based interviews : please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>Life at THG Nutrition</strong></p> <p> </p> <p data-start="353" data-end="578">THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.</p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776">Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role: Category Manager | Bars & Snacks</strong></p> <p><strong>Reporting to: Category Director</strong></p> <p><strong>Brand: Myprotein</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: THG HQ, Manchester (WA15 0AF) - Fully Office Based</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Nutrition:</strong></p> <p>THG Nutrition is home to some of the best loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, and its family of brands,  Myvitamins and MP Activewear. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries; to power and empower those who want more.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>As the Category Manager, you will be responsible for driving the online commercial success of Bars & Snacks. You will optimise the ecommerce strategy for these categories, ensuring commercial growth and customer engagement across global markets in line with out omni-channel business.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><em><strong>Category Performance & Strategy</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement bars & snacks strategies to maximise online sales, market share, and profitability.</li> <li>Analyse internal insights (sales data, pricing trends, site metrics) to make data-driven decisions that optimise category performance.</li> <li>Identify category growth opportunities, leveraging global and regional insights to tailor strategies for each market.</li> <li>Conduct frequent site audits to ensure optimal customer experience (CX) and category visibility.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Market & Competitor Analysis</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Monitor external market trends, including competitor pricing, innovation, and emerging category trends.</li> <li>Leverage insights to develop category plans and influence product launches, pricing, and promotional strategies.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Brand & Marketing teams to align product positioning with industry trends and customer demand.</li> <li>Collaborate with the internal Retail, Wholesale, Tiktok & Amazon teams to understand insights & omnichannel sales to drive online decisions.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Pricing & Promotion Optimisation</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the pricing strategy for assigned categories, ensuring profitability while remaining competitive in each market.</li> <li>Work closely with country managers to optimise pricing across Myprotein sites, balancing growth and margin targets.</li> <li>Work closely with the internal Retail, Wholesale, Tiktok & Amazon teams to balance the calendar plans to drive growth across channels</li> <li>Develop and implement promotional plans, working with digital marketing teams to drive customer acquisition and retention.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Partner with supply chain & production teams to ensure optimal stock availability across all international warehouses.</li> <li>Collaborate with procurement, finance & logistics to improve cost efficiencies and bottom-line profitability.</li> <li>Support senior stakeholders in optimising locale & sales channels mix, reducing cost prices, and managing discount strategies.</li> <li>Work closely with customer service teams to address category-specific customer concerns, ensuring a customer-centric approach to category management.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Performance Tracking & Reporting</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain reporting processes to track category performance at a territory level.</li> <li>Present insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.</li> <li>Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and adjust strategies accordingly to drive category success.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in Ecommerce, Category Management, or Digital Trading, ideally within retail, FMCG, or nutrition/bars & snacks sectors.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.</li> <li>Commercial mindset with experience in pricing, promotion, and margin optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders across marketing, finance, supply chain, and country teams.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with a strong understanding of customer experience (CX) and ecommerce best practices.</li> <li>Proficiency in analytics tools (e.g., BI platforms i.e. Tableau) and ecommerce platforms.</li> <li>Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.</li> <li>Proficiency in excel, SQL & Ai Tools would be desirable as well, but not essential</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Location: Omega, WA5 3TP (3 days) / Icon 1, WA15 0AF (1 day) / WFH (1 day)</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">About THG Manufacturing</span></strong></p> <p><strong>THG Manufacturing</strong> is the dedicated, high-growth contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing division of THG PLC. Operating from state-of-the-art, BRCGS-accredited manufacturing facilities globally, we partner with prestigious household names and global powerhouse brands who trust us to formulate, produce, and scale their product ranges.</p> <p>Our specialised manufacturing capabilities include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Powder Blending</strong> (sports nutrition, lifestyle powders, functional health formulations)</li> <li><strong>Tablets & Capsules</strong> (vitamins, minerals, and dietary supplements)</li> <li><strong>Protein Bar Manufacturing</strong> (extruded, layered, and premium enrobed formats)</li> <li><strong>Fruit Preparations & Concentrates</strong> (aseptic processing and clean-label infusions)</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Unrivaled Growth Trajectory</strong></p> <p>This is an exceptional time to join our division. THG Manufacturing achieved <strong>300% growth this year</strong>, is forecast to deliver another <strong>100% growth next year</strong>, and is firmly on track to expand into a <strong>£100 million division within 5 years purely in co-manufacturing</strong>. Global powerhouse brands trust us under multi-year co-manufacturing agreements, validating our industry credibility, technical excellence, and manufacturing reliability.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly organised, proactive, and customer-focused <strong>Account Liaison Officer </strong>to join our fast-paced co-manufacturing division, reporting directly into the <strong>Commercial Director</strong>.</p> <p>In this role, you will serve as the primary operational conduit between our valued external co-manufacturing partners and internal site functions, including Production, Planning, Logistics, and Quality. You will drive day-to-day operational execution, clear customer communication, and end-to-end order tracking—ensuring customer forecasts, purchase orders, production timelines, and stock reconciliations run smoothly from inception through to dispatch.</p> <p><strong>As an Account Liaison Officer you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Customer Liaison & Communication</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Point of Contact:</strong> Act as the first port of call for day-to-day customer enquiries regarding production updates, lead times, batch progress, and dispatch schedules.</li> <li><strong>Customer Updates & Reviews:</strong> Prepare and participate in regular operational update calls with customers, providing transparent visibility on open order status and delivery milestones.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination:</strong> Collaborate closely with internal factory teams (Planning, Production, Materials Management, Quality, and Dispatch) to ensure client requirements are understood and executed smoothly.</li> <li><strong>Escalation Support:</strong> Promptly raise and track operational bottlenecks or supply chain escalations with internal stakeholders and the Commercial Director, keeping customers proactively informed of resolutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demand, Supply & Production Coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Demand Planning Interface:</strong> Collate customer demand forecasts and align them with internal planners to assess production line capacity and material requirements.</li> <li><strong>Supply Planning & OTIF Monitoring:</strong> Track component and raw material deliveries to support target On-Time, In-Full (OTIF) manufacturing schedules.</li> <li><strong>Production & Kitting Schedules:</strong> Liaise with site operational teams across our powder blending, bar, tableting, and fruit preparation plants to monitor kitting activities and scheduled production runs.</li> <li><strong>Supply Health Tracking:</strong> Support regular supply health and risk reporting, flagging potential raw material or component shortages before they impact production plans.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Order Processing & Systems Administration</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Order Processing:</strong> Accurately translate customer purchase orders into production and planning schedules across THG’s planning systems.</li> <li><strong>THG Ingenuity Systems:</strong> Raise, monitor, and coordinate production orders within THG’s proprietary Ingenuity platform.</li> <li><strong>B2B Portal & Price List Set-Up:</strong> Assist with setting up customer price lists on the THGB2B portal and ensure quarterly pricing uploads and system adjustments are maintained accurately in line with agreed terms.</li> <li><strong>New Product Range Administration:</strong> Assist in setting up initial reporting suites, tracking master SKU data, and ensuring data alignment for new product range introductions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Inventory Reconciliation & Operational Control</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Free-Issued Stock Reconciliation:</strong> Perform regular reconciliations of customer-supplied (free-issued) raw materials, packaging, and ingredients, tracking usage, investigating discrepancies, and reporting remaining balances.</li> <li><strong>Finance & Timings Alignment:</strong> Provide timely order movement and production timing updates to the Commercial Director and Finance teams to support revenue tracking and month-end financial reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What skills and experience do I need for this role?</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience in a customer service, client liaison, supply chain coordination, account coordination, or production administration role (ideally within FMCG, food & beverage, packaging, or manufacturing).</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to maintain clear, professional, and positive customer relationships.</li> <li>High accuracy in order processing, stock reconciliation, and maintaining system data.</li> <li>Basic understanding of production workflows, material lead times, and supply chain processes.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, reporting spreadsheets) and comfort working with ERP, MRP, or proprietary ordering portals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience working within contract manufacturing (co-man) or third-party client operations.</li> <li>Familiarity with food, nutrition, or pharmaceutical manufacturing standards (e.g., BRCGS, GMP).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Working Pattern & Office Locations</strong></p> <p>Collaboration and close proximity to our manufacturing plants are essential to our operational velocity. This role follows a <strong>hybrid model (4 days on-site / 1 day remote)</strong>:</p> <ul> <li><strong>3 Days per week:</strong> THG Omega Campus, Warrington (flagship operational & manufacturing campus)</li> <li><strong>1 Day per week:</strong> Icon 1, Manchester Airport (THG Global Headquarters)</li> <li><strong>1 Day per week:</strong> Flexible Work from Home (WFH)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for me?</strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Know s
